import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    a, b = 0, 1
    ret = x / y
    rett = 0
    for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        val1 = math.floor(ret * i)
        val2 = math.ceil(ret * i)
        if abs(ret - val1 / i) + 1e-15 < abs(ret - rett):
            a = val1
            b = i
            rett = val1 / i
        if abs(ret - val2 / i) + 1e-15 < abs(ret - rett):
            a = val2
            b = i
            rett = val2 / i
    gcd_ab = math.gcd(a, b)
    print(f"{a // gcd_ab}/{b // gcd_ab}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
